title: MapSnapshot
description: What GET /v1/regions/{id}/cells returns. Student C produces this; Student B renders it. Source: Terrastep plan section 15 (access boundaries) and section 19 (location privacy). This is a SANITIZED PROJECTION, not the ownership table. Plan section 19: the privacy projection is part of the API contract, not a visual filter applied after downloading full data.

region_id.description: An explicitly versioned cell set. Plan section 11: fix pilot region membership as an explicit versioned cell set; H3 parent-child membership is logically exact but parent outlines do not exactly enclose the union of child boundaries.

as_of.description: Freshness time. Public projections carry a privacy delay of at least 30 minutes after the session ends (plan section 19). Always show this to the user so a stale map is never mistaken for a live one.

cursor.description: Version cursor. Pass it back to fetch only changes since this snapshot. Plan section 14: batch changes and provide a version cursor.

h3_resolution.description: Fixed at 9 for the pilot (~0.1053 km^2 average hexagon, ~200.8 m average edge). Plan section 11: never mix resolutions within one competition without an explicit migration.

cells.description: Sparse. Only occupied or masked cells appear - never billions of pre-created world rows (plan section 11).

h3_id.description: Lowercase hex H3 index as TEXT. Never a JSON number.

owner.description: Null for a neutral cell. Plan section 19: a nickname is not anonymity, and repeated public cell ownership can reveal home, workplace and routines. Only the fields below are ever exposed - no user id, no last-seen time, no capture history.

avatar_ref.description: A reference to a re-encoded, EXIF-stripped image. Plan section 15: validate file types and sizes, re-encode, strip EXIF location metadata before publication.

score_micro.description: Effective score in fixed-point micro-points (score x 1e6), as a digit string. Deliberately text, for the same reason H3 ids are text: JSON Schema's `integer` type accepts 8.0, and once a float touches a score, replays stop being bit-identical. Plan section 9 requires fixed-point. The client parses to a 64-bit integer and divides by 1e6 for display.

color.description: Server-assigned display colour, so the client cannot fingerprint owners by choosing colours.

version.description: Increments on every ownership change. Consumers deduplicate by event id and version - delivery may repeat (plan section 17, at-least-once with idempotent effects).

masked.description: True when excluded from ranked contribution - water, high-speed road, restricted location, or a locally reported hazard. Plan section 11. A masked cell still renders; it simply cannot be captured.

pending.description: True when the current user has an unverified claim on this cell. Plan section 10: the app may show provisional progress but must NOT announce a verified capture while offline.
